criterion_bindings.exemption: Process authority is enforced by repository validators, not executed scenarios: GitHub Issues are the planning surface by rule 1, and repository content is bounded by scripts/check-public-content.py.
Merge evidence authority is enforced structurally by scripts/check-commit-title.py and the required checks of .github/workflows/ci.yml.
Default-branch implementation is rejected by test_default_branch_history_is_clean (scripts/test-commit-title.py) over the accepted history.
Law-conflict surfacing is enforced by scripts/check-knowledge-closure.py --strict, which requires every document to carry an accepted record or explicit disposition.
Session identity and authoritative issue linkage are enforced by the concord session boot contract, the capture external_ref contract, and their CLI and agent contract tests.
Durable transition, evidence, and completion records are enforced by the generated agent contracts and store workflow tests.
Replacement readiness is checked by scripts/check-floor-readiness.py against the accepted floor manifest and executable evidence anchors.
The no-predecessor-write boundary is enforced by scripts/check-predecessor-independence.py.

summary: Defines Concord's development workflow after issue #600 while GitHub retains planning, review, and merge authority under CD-0089.
title: development authority
